under section 4;
fails to notify the Commissioner-General of
any  matters  required  to  be  notified  under
section  7;
fails to furnish a return under section 8;
having  appeared  before  an  officer  of  the
Department of Inland Revenue in compliance
with a notice issued to him under section 8
fails, without sufficient cause, to answer any
question  lawfully  put  to  him  by  an  officer
acting under this Act;
gives  any  incorrect  information  relating  to
any matter or thing affecting his own liability
to levy or the liability of any other person;
pays the amount under section 29 to any other
person  other  than  the  officer  named  in  the
notice;
